record.title: Add Separate Recovery And Rest Recommendation Layer
record.description: Add a separate backend and product lane for recovery summaries, rest recommendations, and next-set prompts. This may use set timestamps, session history, and any later bounded timing truth, but it must remain a separate concern from the toggleable exercise timer feature. The app can later surface deterministic guidance such as likely rest windows or recovery patterns without redefining the user-facing exercise timer as a rest timer.
